Improved API discovery UX with evidence-origin filters, readable domain groups, honest empty states, and derived source-screen and inferred-journey usage.
Improved Atlas orientation with readable surface navigation, counts in accessibility metadata, and keyboard tab movement.

Context schema version 7 adds project recognition, source transitions, inferred journeys, and independently queryable inferred steps.
Studio now presents source-derived journey candidates separately from authoritative recorded flows.
Adapter scaffolding and inventory now include flow-discovery modules and exact transition and inferred-journey ownership.
Topo now recognizes project capabilities and derives source-backed transitions and read-only journey candidates from one incremental source snapshot.
Exposed complete bounded API endpoint records through the canonical read-only MCP context interface.
Added schema-version-six API endpoint records, adapter relationships, bounded queries, and malformed-source issues.
Added API endpoint adapter scaffolding, conformance, configuration, and exact endpoint inventory membership.
Added version-five 10,000-operation source API and OpenAPI workloads plus measured parser fast paths.
Added stable API endpoint search results and addressable APIs destination selection.
Added normalized API endpoint discovery, Studio atlas, LLM and MCP records, cross-framework fixtures, and sub-50ms 10,000-operation benchmarks.
Reduce contract-checked daemon source refresh p95 from 50.327 ms to 32.514 ms while retaining default graph validation
Measure all six built-in framework adapters at 10,000 routes under the 50 ms hot-path ceiling.
Extend setup, native runtimes, and source intelligence across React, Vue, Nuxt, and Svelte projects.
Add built-in React, Vue, Nuxt, and Svelte route discovery with native browser fixtures.
Added measured Studio route preloads, batched capture, semantic daemon refresh, coalesced LLM durability, and a thin CLI bootstrap
Add strict before-after performance comparisons, sub-50 ms hot-path gates, validated graph and scanner fast paths, on-demand Pixi rendering, and a production website performance contract.
Support explicit nested, adjacent, linked, and absolute application source roots while retaining all durable Topo writes under the project root.
Report ambiguous mixed-framework project roots through the stable application.source-selection Doctor check with exact LLM-readable evidence and remediation.
Validate rootDir as an existing contained application directory and reject traversal, file targets, and linked escapes before source discovery.
The signed preview bridge now exposes bounded exact-origin event subscriptions
Signed live preview journeys can now be traced into durable LLM-readable flows
Addressable component preview variants now display exact captured, failed, unavailable, or uncaptured evidence in Studio
The managed local-runtime proof now verifies selected Screen by default, a reload-safe zero-frame Map, and return to the same signed native screen.
Routes now open on selected-screen evidence, expose a reload-safe organized map, preserve exact screen identity across presentations, and retain unclipped visual evidence thumbnails.
Made every route interaction probe independently searchable, selectable, URL-addressable, and reload-safe in the Paper-matched Studio probe view.
Matched Components to the Paper coverage-and-screen-evidence board, retained the complete topology as an addressable Map mode, and corrected the shared canvas to exact 14px side and bottom insets.
Move strict Studio validation out of the static shell, lower initial JavaScript budgets, and enforce the boundary in source, showcase, and packed CLI builds.
The website now packages a verified, hashed production Studio bundle as its default same-origin demo.

Local adapter scaffolds now have a process-free versioned conformance command that verifies manifest identity, module loading, and framework, preview, or runtime contracts before real-project testing.
Editor now searches complete screen and component inventories, discloses bounded preview limits, and preserves exact finding identity through Doctor navigation.
Doctor now preserves canonical scopes, shows every finding, copies remediation, and retains exact finding identity through report, search, URL, and reload.
Made Notes searchable and inspect-first with stable previous/next navigation, disclosed editing, safe cancellation, and production browser contracts.
Made Atlas Flows inspect-first with readable selected-lane framing, compact route-break evidence, disclosed editors, and an ordered step navigator.
Top-align selected route regions and keep route and component navigators focused on compact, visible selections.
Verify every benchmarked LLM record against exported schemas outside the timed projection interval
Index graph relationships once and validate canonical record envelopes without cloning typed payloads
Measure complete scans and one-file scanner-session refreshes as separate CPU workloads

Preserved explicit flow edges and selected-step anchoring across balanced multi-row scene layout.

Validate and expose the version-two five-check Studio build report in the isolated packed CLI consumer.
